name: efs
description: Amazon Elastic File System Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) provides simple, scalable file storage for use with Amazon EC2 Linux and Mac instances in the Amazon Web Services Cloud.

subcommands.name: create-access-point
subcommands.description: Creates an EFS access point.

options.name: --client-token
options.description: A string of up to 64 ASCII characters that Amazon EFS uses to ensure idempotent creation

options.name: --tags
options.description: Creates tags associated with the access point.

options.name: --file-system-id
options.description: The ID of the EFS file system that the access point provides access to

options.name: --posix-user
options.description: The operating system user and group applied to all file system requests made using the access point

options.name: --root-directory
options.description: Specifies the directory on the EFS file system that the access point exposes as the root directory of your file system to NFS clients using the access point.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.
